We can use sys.stdin.read().split() or input().split(). Then compute.

import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data: return
    m, n = map(int, data[:2])

    for i in range(1, m):
        for j in range(1, n):
            dp[j] += dp[j-1]
    print(dp[-1])

if __name__ == "__main__":
